clock_notes.convention: camera clock: EXIF DateTimeOriginal labelled +02:00 in every run (the camera stayed on UTC+2 all year and did not follow DST); UTC = camera time - 2 h. The camera runs fast against the file-write clock by the amount in clock_checks.

t0.note: Frames' elapsed_h in the production path are relative to the camera-clock t0; the staged atmosphere_series uses origin_datetime = the legacy injection start (naive, folder/MFC clock). Both mark the same physical instant; their UTC estimates differ by the camera offset (camera_utc_minus_legacy_utc_s).
